blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Match each inequality with its graph.
blocks.display: Match each inequality with its graph.

blocks.text: X is greater than two: an open circle at two, shaded to the right.
blocks.display: x > 2 → Open circle at 2, shaded right

blocks.text: X is less than or equal to negative one: a closed circle at negative one, shaded to the left.
blocks.display: x ≤ −1 → Closed circle at −1, shaded left

blocks.text: X is greater than or equal to three: a closed circle at three, shaded to the right.
blocks.display: x ≥ 3 → Closed circle at 3, shaded right

blocks.text: X is less than negative two: an open circle at negative two, shaded to the left.
blocks.display: x < −2 → Open circle at −2, shaded left

blocks.text: Greater than shades to the right and less than shades to the left. A circle that is open leaves the number out, and a circle that is filled in keeps it.
